comment: Reference peaks vs automatically detected peaks

steps: Run ensemble detector on each test record → det_peaks
Re-run identical inter-patient pipeline on the new BeatSet
Report Δ-acc / Δ-wF1 relative to reference-peak Table 2 numbers

manuscript_paragraph_template: All classification numbers in the main tables use the reference annotations, as is standard for the AAMI inter-patient benchmark. To quantify the practical impact of automatic detection we evaluated the ensemble R-peak detector under the AAMI EC57 matching criterion (150 ms) and then re-ran the entire feature-extraction + linear-SVC pipeline on the detected peaks with labels transferred by nearest-neighbour matching.  Detector sensitivity / positive predictivity on the DS2 records were Se = <fill>, +P = <fill>.  The resulting classification weighted-F1 differed from the reference-peak figure by Δ = <fill> (Table Y).  The gap is dominated by the small fraction of spurious detections that receive no label and are therefore discarded; once a peak is matched the downstream classifier performance is essentially unchanged.
